**Overview:**  
Global Pacific Perunding Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company that provides management consulting services to small‑ and medium‑sized enterprises. It is incorporated on 2014‑01‑15 and operates out of the state of Perak. The firm has a share capital of 500,000 and is governed by three directors, with the largest shareholder owning 58.7% of the equity. No former names are recorded, and there are no legal cases listed against the company.
